name: Awesome HORIZON SHIELD
what: Every database, MCP server and verification ledger operated by The HORIZONs K.K., with a verification path per row.

operator.conflict_of_interest: The operator sells paid services. Every row therefore ships with a way to check it without trusting the operator.

datasets.title: Japan Home-visit Nursing Reimbursement Database (JHNRD)
datasets.design: Sources ranked statute/agency/secondary; unconfirmed stays confirmed:false; conflicts keep both claims; searches that found nothing are recorded.
datasets.counted_by: JHNRD 自身の status.json (tools/validate.py が出す数)。こちらで数え直さない。

datasets.title: JIDEC public verification ledger (NENRIN)
datasets.note: Audit records the operator cannot alter or delete; every record's sha256 is recomputable.

mcp_servers.never_says: prices; unverified stores are never shown (fail-closed)
算定できます, returns requirements and sources, never the judgement; enforced by 72 automated checks

mcp_servers.role: the measuring gate; measures itself too

not_a_normal_awesome_list.rows_added_by: nobody by hand; a server is measured and the register writes the row
not_a_normal_awesome_list.placement_for_money: no code path exists to add or remove a row for money
not_a_normal_awesome_list.unflattering_records: retained by design; no route to quietly drop them
not_a_normal_awesome_list.author_stake: The HORIZONs K.K. sells services to these industries and discloses it

get_listed.who: contractors, renovation firms, one-person shops, home-visit nursing operators
get_listed.condition: pass the independent KIRA fair-price audit (checks estimates against 65,520 JCCDB items); no pass, no listing
get_listed.you_get: your own MCP endpoint https://p0NN.horizonshield.dev/mcp answering in your name, plus a public daily conduct history you cannot edit

falsify.what: report a row you cannot verify, a number that will not reproduce, or a source that does not match
falsify.handling: confirmed findings are kept in the open, with credit
